name: EH3D-THERMAL-LAB
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: early code. A Rust library and command line that compute the temperature rise of a copper trace with a current (Joule effect with temperature-dependent resistance, cooling by convection) and across a series and parallel network of thermal resistances, and refuse a result that lacks hypotheses, boundary conditions, materials, uncertainty, limitations or range of validity; a case out of range or without convergence gives no number. It has only run on cases made by its own tests and closed-form values; nothing was compared with a solver or a measurement, and the heat sources, the geometry coupling and the comparison with measurements are not written.
